purpose: Authorize one bounded fail-closed repair to the exact-head CI snapshot used by the review gate. Historical GitHub Actions workflow runs for the same exact SHA must not remain blocking after a newer workflow run of the same workflow has executed. This authority changes review-controller observation semantics only; it does not weaken any CI, review, provider, product or runtime requirement.

observedFailure.blockingReason: ci-not-green:platform-v7 autopilot guard historical duplicate checks
observedFailure.causalInvariant: For one workflow_id on one exact head, workflow run_number determines workflow execution recency. Rerunning an older run_number later in wall-clock time must not supersede a newer run_number.

requiredChange.summary: Canonicalize GitHub Actions checks to the authoritative workflow execution before evaluating terminal-green CI. Preserve all current exact-head, provider, owner-audit and fail-closed requirements.

requiredTests: Older FAILURE run_number followed by newer SUCCESS run_number for the same workflow_id and exact head reduces to the newer SUCCESS execution.
Older SUCCESS run_number followed by newer FAILURE run_number for the same workflow_id and exact head reduces to the newer FAILURE execution and blocks.
A later wall-clock rerun of an older run_number cannot supersede a newer run_number.
Duplicate check names within the selected workflow run reduce only by a strictly ordered parseable startedAt; malformed or ambiguous ordering fails closed.
Workflow-run metadata whose head_sha does not equal the exact PR head fails closed.
Missing or malformed workflow_id, run_number, run id or Actions details URL required for duplicate-run reduction fails closed rather than ignoring a substantive check.
Existing exact-head binding, review-gate self-deadlock exclusions, provider-review availability exclusions, substantive red-check blocking and legacy status-context behavior remain covered.
requiredInvariants: No GitHub Actions check may be marked green by the verifier; the verifier may only select the authoritative already-observed workflow execution and then evaluate its real state.
Historical failures remain visible as historical evidence but are not current CI authority after a newer run_number of the same workflow_id exists on the same exact head.
The newest run_number remains authoritative even if an older workflow run is manually rerun later.
A rerun of the currently authoritative run_number remains authoritative and its latest same-run check occurrence must be evaluated fail closed.
The reducer must not use workflow display name alone when immutable workflow_id metadata is available.
The reducer must not cross exact-head boundaries.
Repo automations and the existing exact-head review gate cannot use this authority PR itself as independent review authority.
No Local Qwen workflow, provider status, model/runtime/policy pin, product/API/database/RBAC/registration/dependency/lockfile/deployment/runtime path may change under this authority.

After this verifier repair legitimately merges, PR #5402 must be re-evaluated on its exact head through the normal gate. Bootstrap classification, if then eligible, remains provider-neutral and is not independent review authority.
After #5402 legitimately merges, substantive PR #5347 still requires a completely fresh exact-head independent Local Qwen review and production acceptance evidence.
